schema.description:
GetWorkspaceInfoResponse carries workspace-level capabilities the UI uses to
tailor what it shows.

canViewUsage.description:
Whether the caller may see the workspace usage page (org permission
"view_billing_data" — workspace owners and billing-managing custom
roles). Gates the Usage navigation item in the UI; GetWorkspaceUsage
enforces the same permission server-side.

isFreeTrial.description:
Whether the workspace is on a free trial. Free-trial sessions are pinned to
an 8-hour auto-terminate window that cannot be changed.

lifecycleHooksEnabled.description:
Whether lifecycle hooks are enabled for this workspace (rollout feature
flag 'rde-lifecycle-hooks', docs/lifecycle-hooks/DESIGN.md). Gates
saving templates with hooks and decides how new sessions start: with
the flag on, new sessions run their hooks through the RDE runner (legacy
templates through a fixed mapping); with it off, they start exactly as
before. Sessions already running on the runner keep working either way.

warmPoolsEnabled.description:
Whether warm pools are enabled for this workspace (rollout feature flag
'rde-warm-pool'). Gates the Warm pools navigation item, the template
actions that create a pool, and CreateWarmPool server-side; pools that
already exist stay manageable and claimable regardless.
